chunks: Let your son play for seven years, and let him be disciplined for seven years, and keep him close to yourself for seven years. Then if he succeeds, otherwise he is among those in whom there is no good.

key_terms.أَفْلَحَ: he succeeds or prospers in his development and conduct
key_terms.أَلْزِمْهُ: keep him attached or close, meaning sustained supervision and companionship
key_terms.ابْنَكَ: your son or child, the focus of the upbringing being discussed
key_terms.لَا خَيْرَ فِيهِ: there is no good in him, indicating failure to benefit from upbringing
key_terms.يَلْعَبْ: to play, indicating an early stage of free childhood activity
key_terms.يُؤَدَّبْ: to be disciplined and trained in proper conduct

ai.seo_question: How should a child be raised according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith outlines a staged approach to raising a child: a period of play, followed by discipline, then close guidance and companionship. It emphasizes gradual moral formation and careful upbringing as central to a child’s successful development.
